messages:
maya: quick follow-up  compact fingerprint + annotations_ref seems promising. what about collisions?

rafi: use HMAC with tenant salt. 64-bit looked ok in sims but consider 128-bit for high-security tenants.

nina: two-layer: fingerprint in router, alias_id in small KV, annotations lazy-fetched for console. keeps hot path tiny.

sam: also need migration path for legacy string pins. on write, synthesize alias and emit audit event.

jon: ops: health-driven eviction must override TTL. propose fields: ttl, health_grace, fallback_order.

infra-bot: deploy note: metadata service needs new IAM roles and a canary rollout. watch annotation_fetch_rate.

maya: action: nina prototype alias store; rafi run collision sims; sam define health semantics; jon write migration plan. target: 2 weeks.

nina: adding metrics: fingerprint_collision_count, alias_resolve_latency_p95, annotation_fetch_miss_rate.

maya: perfect  i'll add to RFC follow-up. thanks!
